mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_screen_person WHERE id_num = #{idNum} AND deleted = 0

SELECT transverse_diameter, longitudinal_diameter, bleb, injection, screen_order, person_id, injection_way, outcome, injection_agency, screen_time, id, blush_transverse_diameter, blush_longitudinal_diameter FROM tb_screen_ppd WHERE person_id = #{patientId} AND year = #{year} AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT computed_tomography_code AS chestRadiographCode, computed_tomography AS chestRadiograph, photo_time AS screenTime, outcome, screen_order, person_id, id FROM tb_screen_computed_tomography WHERE person_id = #{patientId} AND year = #{year} AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT sputum_examination, type, forthwith_sputum, forthwith_sputum_code, evening_sputum, evening_sputum_code, morning_sputum, morning_sputum_code, outcome, screen_time, screen_order, person_id, id FROM tb_screen_sputum_examination WHERE person_id = #{patientId} AND year = #{year} AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT url, id FROM tb_screen_images WHERE id = #{imageId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, more_type AS moreType FROM tb_screen_person WHERE is_new = 1 AND is_screened = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (10, 11, 12)

SELECT id, more_type AS moreType FROM tb_screen_person WHERE is_new = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') in (10, 11, 12)

SELECT sp.id, sp.more_type FROM tb_screen_person sp JOIN ( SELECT person_id FROM tb_screen_diagnosis WHERE outcome IN ( 8, 9 ) AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (10, 11, 12) GROUP BY person_id ) AS diag ON sp.id = diag.person_id

SELECT sp.id, sp.more_type FROM tb_screen_person sp JOIN ( SELECT person_id FROM tb_screen_experiment WHERE ( smear_result = 1 OR culture_result = 1 OR (molecular_biology = 1 OR molecular_biology = 2) ) AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (10, 11, 12) GROUP BY person_id ) AS diag ON sp.id = diag.person_id

SELECT sp.id, sp.more_type FROM tb_screen_person sp JOIN ( SELECT person_id FROM tb_screen_diagnosis WHERE outcome is not null AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (10, 11, 12) GROUP BY person_id ) AS diag ON sp.id = diag.person_id;

SELECT per.id, per.more_type FROM tb_screen_person per JOIN ( SELECT ppd.person_id FROM tb_screen_ppd ppd INNER JOIN tb_screen_computed_tomography ct ON ppd.person_id = ct.person_id INNER JOIN tb_screen_chest_radiograph dr ON ppd.person_id = dr.person_id WHERE ppd.outcome = 1 AND dr.outcome = 0 AND ct.outcome = 0 AND ppd.screen_type = #{screenType} AND ppd.year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(ppd.create_time, '%m') IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(ppd.create_time, '%m') IN (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(ppd.create_time, '%m') IN (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(ppd.create_time, '%m') IN (10, 11, 12) GROUP BY ppd.person_id ) AS diag ON per.id = diag.person_id;

SELECT id, more_type AS moreType FROM tb_screen_person WHERE screen_type = #{screenType} AND year = #{year} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (4, 5, 6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (7, 8, 9) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') IN (10, 11, 12)

SELECT name, age, school_or_temple AS school, classroom, tsp.id_num AS idNum, tspp.screen_time AS ppdScreenTime, tspp.transverse_diameter AS transverseDiameter, tspp.longitudinal_diameter AS longitudinalDiameter, tspp.bleb AS bleb, CASE WHEN tspp.maxScreenOrder1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isDoPpd, tspp.outcome AS outcomePpd, (tspp.transverse_diameter + tspp.longitudinal_diameter) / 2 AS averageDiameter, CASE WHEN (tspp.transverse_diameter + tspp.longitudinal_diameter) / 2 < 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS diameterFlag, tscr.photo_time AS photoTime, CASE WHEN tscr.maxScreenOrder2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isDoX, tscr.outcome AS outcomeDr FROM tb_screen_person AS tsp LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, outcome, screen_type, screen_time, transverse_diameter, longitudinal_diameter, bleb, screen_order AS maxScreenOrder1 FROM tb_screen_ppd WHERE year = #{year} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY id_num, outcome, screen_type, screen_time, transverse_diameter, longitudinal_diameter, bleb, screen_order ORDER BY maxScreenOrder1 DESC LIMIT 1) AS tspp ON tsp.id_num = tspp.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = tspp.screen_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, photo_time, outcome, screen_type, screen_order AS maxScreenOrder2 FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE year = #{year} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY outcome, photo_time, id_num, screen_type, screen_order ORDER BY maxScreenOrder2 DESC LIMIT 1) AS tscr ON tsp.id_num = tscr.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = tscr.screen_type WHERE tsp.id_num = #{idNum} AND tsp.screen_type = #{screenType} AND tsp.year = #{year} AND tsp.deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM tb_screen_person WHERE id_num = #{idNum} AND year = #{year} AND screen_type = #{screenType} AND deptId=#{deptId} AND deleted = 0

select * from tb_screen_ppd where outcome is not null and id_num=#{idNum} and screen_type=#{screenType} and deleted=0 and screen_order=#{screenOrder} and #{curDate} between create_time and DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) order by id desc limit 1

select id, computed_tomography_code computedTomographyCode, outcome, remark,create_time createTime,screen_order screenOrder from tb_screen_computed_tomography where outcome is not null and id_num=#{idNum} and screen_type=#{screenType} and deleted=0 and screen_order=#{screenOrder} and #{curDate} between create_time and DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) order by id desc limit 1

select id, chest_radiograph_code chestRadiographCode, outcome, remark,create_time createTime,screen_order screenOrder from tb_screen_chest_radiograph where outcome is not null and id_num=#{idNum} and screen_type=#{screenType} and deleted=0 and screen_order=#{screenOrder} and #{curDate} between create_time and DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) order by id desc limit 1

select id,screen_order screenOrder,create_time createTime from tb_screen_collect where outcome is not null and id_num=#{idNum} and screen_type=#{screenType} and deleted=0 and screen_order=#{screenOrder} and #{curDate} between create_time and DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) order by id desc limit 1
